query: Run the functional analysis for this application — .indexing-kb/ is ready
expected_behavior: Reads stack.json from .indexing-kb/bronze/ before dispatching any sub-agent
Dispatches actor-feature-mapper, ui-surface-analyst, io-catalog-analyst in parallel (Wave 1)
Dispatches user-flow-analyst and implicit-logic-analyst after Wave 1 (Wave 2)
Runs functional-traceability-auditor in Wave 3b (always ON — not opt-in)
Asks user before overwriting existing docs/analysis/01-functional/ with status: complete

query: The functional analysis at docs/analysis/01-functional/ is complete but the PDF export is missing — regenerate it
expected_behavior: Detects docs/analysis/01-functional/ exists with status: complete in manifest
Detects _exports/ directory is missing or PDF file is absent
Offers exports-only mode as the default recommendation (does NOT re-run all sub-agents)
In exports-only mode: dispatches only document-creator and presentation-creator (no Wave 1/2/3 sub-agents)
Does NOT overwrite existing analysis outputs during exports-only run

query: Run Phase 1 functional analysis — .indexing-kb/ does not exist yet
expected_behavior: Detects .indexing-kb/ is absent or incomplete before dispatching any sub-agent
Stops and asks the user whether to run indexing first (Phase 0) — does NOT auto-invoke indexing-supervisor
Offers degraded-mode option if user wants to proceed anyway, with explicit gap warnings
Does NOT invent a knowledge base or read source code as a substitute for .indexing-kb/
